raw_segments.text: Mr. Trab had sliced his hot roll into three feather beds and was slipping butter in between
the blankets and covering it up.
He was a prosperous old bachelor, and his open window looked into a prosperous little
garden and orchard, and there was a prosperous iron safe led into the wall at the side of
his fireplace, and I did not doubt that heaps of his prosperity were put away in it in bags.
